Frontend · 16 August 2026

Panino UI Harmonization

Nine dialogs had been hand-rolled independently, so the same button, the same input and the same header had drifted into five variants each. This pass replaces the copies with shared primitives and records the rules those primitives enforce.

9Dialogs unified
3Components added
24CSS primitives
21Files touched
254Tests passing

What had drifted

Each row is a class of inconsistency found across the frontend, what it looked like before, and the rule that now governs it.

Category Before Now
Radius Four scales in play: bare rounded (65 uses), rounded-md (71), rounded-lg (36), rounded-full (5), applied without a rule. rounded-md for controls, rounded-lg for containers, rounded-full for pills. Bare rounded eliminated.
Accent colour Primary buttons were bg-gray-800 in seven dialogs but bg-blue-500 in three; selection and progress states used blue; focus rings were gray-500 in 18 places and blue-500 in 4. gray-800 / gray-900 everywhere. Blue reserved for hyperlinks.
Button geometry Five distinct paddings for the same role. Icon gaps set by space-x-1, mr-1, mr-2, gap-1.5 and gap-2. Two sizes (sm, md), four variants, one gap-2. Icon margins removed.
Dialog chrome Nine hand-rolled dialogs. Seven shared a header/footer pattern by copy-paste and drifted; three had no chrome at all. Two had no backdrop dismissal. One BaseModal. Three widths, one header, one footer, one close affordance.
Dialog titles text-xl font-semibold text-gray-800 in modals vs text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 for the same tier on pages; twelve heading variants overall. Six named tiers, pn-title-* / pn-body / pn-meta.
Footer verbs “Done”, “Close” and “Cancel” used interchangeably for the same dismissal role. Done for managers and terminal-action lists; Cancel + primary verb when an action is pending.
Form controls The 130-character input class chain was retyped in six files with three focus-ring variants; four other inputs used a short rounded border chain instead. pn-input / pn-select / pn-textarea, one definition.
Tables Three table implementations with per-cell px-3 py-2 align-middle repeated on every <td> and unstyled headers. pn-table styles its own descendants; cells carry no classes.

The contracts

Six rules, written down in docs/architecture/ui-design-system.md so the next surface does not have to guess.

Radius

Controls take rounded-md. Containers take rounded-lg. Pills and avatars take rounded-full. Nothing takes bare rounded.

Accent

gray-800 and gray-900. Blue belongs to hyperlinks and nothing else — not primaries, not selection, not focus, not progress.

Borders

border-gray-300 on anything interactive, border-gray-200 on dividers and container edges.

Focus

Buttons ring at 2px with a 2px offset; inputs ring at 1px and shift their border. Both in gray-500.

Icon spacing

Spacing comes from gap on the parent, never a margin on the icon. Button icons are h-4 w-4.

Footer verbs

Managers and terminal-action lists close with Done. Anything with a pending action pairs Cancel with the primary verb.

Before and after

Captured from the running dev stack at the same viewport, same data, before and after the change.

Export

Icon alignment

The 8×8 icon was vertically centred against a three-line text block, so it floated beside the description instead of the title. It now sits in a fixed box on the title's first line — the same OptionCard Import uses.

Import

Same job, different component

Import and Export presented the identical “pick a format” list with different icon sizes (5 vs 8), different title weights (medium vs semibold) and different row gaps. Both now render OptionCard.

Global Variables

Button sizes inside one dialog

Add was px-4 py-2 while its own Cancel was px-3 py-2, and the row actions were a fourth size again. Every button is now one of two sizes. Delete moved from a filled red chip to the shared danger weight.

GitHub Backup

Three secondary button sizes

Refresh and Change Repository were px-3 py-1.5; Create Private Repo and Disconnect were px-4 py-2; all four are peers. The footer also said “Close” where every other dialog said Done or Cancel.

New Note from Template

Stray blue accent

Selection used bg-blue-50 with a blue ring and a blue radio, the only blue selection state in the app. Now gray-800, matching every other control. The radio needed accent-gray-800 — there is no forms plugin, so text-* never reached it.

Create New File

A different dialog entirely

This one skipped the shared chrome: no backdrop blur, no header or footer bars, a bg-blue-500 primary, a borderless bg-gray-200 cancel and a bare rounded input. It is now PromptModal, shared with folder creation and rename.

Images

Buttons that read as text

Delete Selected, Refresh, Previous and Next were borderless ghosts on a page where they are the primary controls, and the search field used a bare rounded against the app's rounded-md. Table headers gained a real header treatment.

Templates

Utility-class override hack

The New button forced a primary look through !text-white !bg-gray-800 !hover:bg-gray-900 !px-4 !py-2 — and !hover:bg-gray-900 is not even valid Tailwind, so hover did nothing. It is now variant="primary".

What changed in code

The consolidation is the point: three new components and one CSS layer absorb what nineteen files were each doing by hand.

Kind File Role
New BaseModal.vue Overlay, panel, header, scrolling body, sticky footer
New PromptModal.vue Single-field name prompt; owns its focus
New OptionCard.vue Shared format-picker row for Import and Export
Rewritten BaseButton.vue 4 variants × 2 sizes, icon-only, active state
Extended assets/main.css 24 pn-* primitives in @layer components
Converted ExportModal, ImportModal, VariablesModal, TemplateVariableDialog, TemplatePickerModal, ImageLibraryModal, GitHubBackupModal Now compose BaseModal + BaseButton
Converted Documents.vue, TreeItem.vue Three bespoke dialogs → PromptModal; context menu restyled
Normalised SubMenuBar.vue 14 toolbar buttons and 2 inputs → pn-toolbar-*
Normalised TemplateManagerPage, ImageManagerPage, SettingsPage, StyleCustomizer, AuthForm, ChangePasswordForm, PwaInstallPrompt, RevisionPanel, LoadingPage, TermsOfServicePage Adopted the shared primitives
Updated utils/githubBackupProgress.js Active progress step moved off blue; its unit test updated to match

Verification and open items

  • npm run test:fe — 254 tests across 17 files pass.
  • npm run lint — 0 errors (41 pre-existing no-console warnings unchanged).
  • vite build — clean; only the pre-existing dynamic-import chunking warnings.
  • Every data-testid preserved; container-level ids that were already shadowed by parent fall-through were dropped.
  • Two behaviour changes worth knowing: Import now dismisses on backdrop click like every other dialog (still blocked mid-import), and disabled primaries use opacity-50 rather than bg-gray-300.
  • frontend/src/style.css is unused Vite scaffold containing a global button rule that would fight this system. Left in place, safe to delete.
  • The Templates action column can overflow its card below ~1100px. It scrolls, but the column set is dense.
